reviews.text: David with Michael’s Solar Screens did an amazing job. I sent him the measurements and he made the screens and only one trip to install them. I didn’t even need to be home. Reasonable priced and friendly to work with.  Now my turf is protected and the room stays cooler when the sun beats into it.
reviews.author: Nicole Hill

reviews.text: Excellent job! Love my new screens, professional, prompt service - affordable. High quality, a great man, awesome customer service, thank you!!
reviews.author: K L

reviews.text:
The great jobs have been done for installing the solar screens and replacing the window screen for my house in plano today. David and his assistant came on time as in the schedule, and both of them are good workers with very excellent attitude to support all customer’s needs!
I’m very pleased the work they have done and highly recommend Michael Solar Screens.
reviews.author: sammy8617

reviews.text:
I love our new screens for our son’s room. It has significantly helped with lowering the temperature in his room since being installed.
David was quick to respond to my questions and was at my house within 48 hours to do the install and he did a fantastic job.
reviews.author: Cregg Moore

reviews.text:
I love my new solar screens! David was amazing from start to finish. He came out for quick measurements, had samples on hand, and provided a very generous quote for the job.
In 4 days I had my new screens. They look amazing and I highly recommend Michael’s Solar screens. Thank you!
reviews.author: janine DeHoyos

reviews.text: David did a great job on our window screens! He delivered exactly what he promised — on time and with quality workmanship. The screens fit perfectly and look great. We’re really happy with the results and would definitely recommend his service to others.
reviews.author: Amy

reviews.text:
My dog ran through my patio screen door. I requested an estimate from these guys and the company that built my screened in patio. David responded with a great estimate which I was certain would beat the other. He came shortly after same day and fixed in about 15 mins. Took the other vendor about 3 hours to get back to ask for pics. They never followed back up.

Not every fix can be done on site I'm sure but I was lucky. Having worked with these guys before I knew they were fair fast and did quality work even if they needed to take the screen with them.

In my mind...I have a screen guy.
reviews.author: D “Davideo” D

reviews.text: Great job by David and his crew to place 2 solar screens on our bedroom windows. Very courteous and provided service at a great price. Pat Fowler

Relatively low review count (31) for a perfect score
authentic_signals: Mention of specific processes (measurements, samples, installation)
Varied project types (protecting turf, cooling rooms)
Different writing styles and author names
Mention of reasonable pricing and quick response
